unresolved_call_decision_groups.rationale: The extractor follows caller-supplied detached long-horizon self-review/appraisal digests and exact raw-value fields through fail-closed validation and canonical JSON-to-SHA-256 integrity construction. Generic digest/evidence propagation conservatively collides with an unrelated archived restore helper that performs path.open/fh.read, but this self-identity binding module imports no file or persistence surface and invokes no restore helper. It only verifies already supplied review-to-appraisal integrity and constructs immutable detached evidence; it does not acquire input, ingest raw social feedback, poll hardware, mutate identity/self-model/memory, read persistence, emit expression, install runtime capture, or grant authority.
unresolved_call_decision_groups.denial_semantics: Fail-closed review/appraisal digest rejection and local integrity hashing are audit-visible validation only. They grant no runtime read, identity mutation, self-model or memory write, raw-social ingestion, hardware polling, persistence access, expression path, observation-window transition, cutover, or M3-E authority.
